THARGOID BATTLE MUSIC

Put up to 24 OGG Vorbis files in this folder. MP3 files are also supported.

The game scans this folder when it starts. During a Thargoid hyperspace
interdiction it fades away from the current radio source and shuffles music
from this folder. When the encounter ends, the selected radio station returns.

Supported sample rates: 8,000-48,000 Hz. Mono and stereo are supported.
The MUSIC level controls battle music. Radio OFF does not disable dramatic
battle music; set MUSIC to 0 if you want all music muted.

No conversion or special filename is required. Copy the .ogg files here before
starting the game. If this folder is empty, the game uses its generated Pixel
Comet action score.
